clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country to buy an apple orchard in March 1952: June's anxiety rose as she wrote daily to her sister back in Millbrook, Walter distanced from June as he worked the orchard from dark to dark, Glen began fighting at his new school, Walter cut off from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's functioning fell as she kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, Walter and June fought over money for new trees. By September 1953, when June joined the church choir and her letters to Edna thinned out, the period settled; her anxiety dropped and her functioning came back.

clusters.name: The orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drank heavily, Glen and Walter blamed each other over the loan, Glen and Marian took over the family's money and talks with the bank as Glen began overfunctioning, Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter, Nora began wetting the bed in April 1969 as the family moved to Ridgeport, Ida's heart trouble was found and she was told to stop working. By October 1969, when Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, his functioning rose and the period settled.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen's functioning fell as he sat out of work most of that year in the truck, loud fights broke out between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night as she overfunctioned, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, Nora kept to her room and distanced from Marian, Walter began drinking again after six years off it. By June 1976, when Glen started driving a delivery truck for the feed store, the period settled; Nora's functioning rose as she ate again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Nora distanced from Sam as he worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows, Sam turned toward his mother and took her side, Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice, Wilma took over Lily's care as she overfunctioned, Nora's eczema flared on both hands, Nora and Sam fought most nights. By June 1991, when Wilma took a flat in town, the period settled; Nora's symptom cleared over the summer.
